summary: Register idle residency evidence readers before enabling writers

replay.detail: No producer or historical evidence replay is activated.

schema.detail: No SQLite schema or storage version changes; the replicated claim registry gains eight residency evidence kinds.

rules.detail: The registry digest and durable retention inventory add the residency subject family and evidence kinds. Deploy this reader baseline before enabling any residency writer. Checkpoint rules version is unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Older registries quarantine residency evidence as unknown kinds. Upgraded readers admit original records using the existing quarantine replay path. No client-v0 response fields change.

downtime.detail: No added startup scan, migration, or enabled producer.

manual.detail: No operator action until a separately reviewed residency writer cutover.

recovery.detail: This inert reader change writes no residency evidence. Older readers retain existing unknown-kind quarantine behavior; no database rollback is required.
